name: alibaba-models
description: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) — Qwen chat and embedding models. Image generation too (Qwen-Image, Wan), and more. Select your regional endpoint.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: API Key
x-meta.help: Your Alibaba Model Studio API key. Falls back to ALIBABA_API_KEY env var.

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: A Model Studio model id, such as qwen-plus. The model this instance answers with when nothing in Settings → Models names one. Leave it empty to choose its models in Settings → Models.

x-meta.label: Endpoint
x-meta.help: Regional API endpoint. Token Plan users select their plan endpoint; workspace users enter their workspace URL.
